data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis #2, CRITICAL): dd-3 completeness assertion = ANY remaining site (count >= 1) is INCOMPLETE — NOT the >=threshold sweep-classification rule. migration-class-detect.sh has NO count/completeness mode (only a thresholded sweep|db|inconclusive verdict). After the sweep, 1 site remains (the omitted one); 1 < threshold(>=3) would WRONGLY classify as inconclusive/complete if the test reuses detect.sh/threshold logic. The completeness check MUST run sg directly, COUNT matches, and assert incomplete when count>=1 (zero-remaining = complete). Add an AC explicitly forbidding reuse of the threshold comparison for completeness. Verify: the test source shows a direct sg count with a >=1 (not >=threshold) incomplete condition.
